title: Mapping the impact of housing shortage on oil workers (homelessness 2013)
method: Read homeless_data.xlsx Sheet1 (53 rows: 50 states + DC + PR + blank), join to USA_States.shp on L0USA_St_1 = State (51 matched, PR unmatched), add HomelessPopPer10k = Homeless13 / Pop13 * 10 000, map it (ND 28.6 per 10k, US median 13.5) and the 2012-13 change (ND +201 %).
benchmark_defects: The reference reads the .xlsx with a minimal zip/XML reader. Solutions may equally use pandas.read_excel or the Sheet1__* columns already joined in the shapefile.
USA_States.shp already contains a join (Sheet1__St/Ch/Po/Ho) and the rounded result field HomelessPe, so the answer is partly present in the input.
The instruction says the states layer is joined 'using state abbreviations' but the dataset description does not list USA_States.shp or its key field (L0USA_St_1).
Mojibake in domain knowledge (in '2012-2013'); 'save the maps' does not name files or the field to compute.
The instruction names no calculated field; the rate / change field is therefore optional and the join itself is required.
checks: required: at least one non-blank PNG map

required: the join - code reads homeless_data.xlsx and a states-layer table (geometry or the layer's attribute columns) carries an xlsx value (Homeless13, Pop13, Change x1/x100, or a rate from them) aligned per state for >= 95 % of states; positional joins and the pre-joined Sheet1__*/HomelessPe fields fail

optional: calculated field - Homeless13/Pop13 in a rate unit (per 10k/100k/1k, per capita, percent), or the 2012-13 change joined from the xlsx, for >= 95 % of states (pre-joined HomelessPe not credited unless the xlsx is read)

required: map colours rank-match the joined homelessness data - rate, 2012-13 change or 2013 homeless count (|rho| >= 0.9 or class intervals); population alone fails; UNVERIFIABLE if no colour data captured
